semiconductor_relevance: High — The company specializes in semiconductor manufacturing equipment, which is crucial for the production process.
summary: SINTAIKE SEMICONDUCTOR EQUIPMENT(SHANGHAI) CO., LTD. provides advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment, including Wafer Surface Systems, Laminating Machines, and UV Curing Systems. The company focuses on delivering customized solutions to enhance semiconductor production processes, leveraging its independent intellectual property and production capabilities.

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in Shanghai, with a focus on manufacturing and R&D.
regional_presence.Japan: Additional R&D and production facilities located in Tokyo.
